description: A ground-level photograph depicts a group of children playing football (soccer) on an artificial turf pitch. The pitch is green with white markings, and several children are visible, with one child in an orange top appearing in the foreground-middle actively engaged with a football. In the background, there are goalposts, boundary fences, and a dense line of trees, suggesting the edge of an urban or suburban area. The sky is bright, indicating daylight conditions. The image serves as an example of green urban areas, specifically sport and leisure facilities, located in Täby, Sweden.
